purpose: Single-setting descriptive paired numerical repair on previously inspected test structures
development_decision: Only one existing development receptor and previously inspected labels; insufficient independent development support. No sweep, no selection, no subsequent retuning.

baseline_parameters.hyperparameter_selection: Single a-priori setting; no CASF hyperparameter search

water.radius_definition: RDKit van der Waals radii, exactly the original PB water catalog; water O radius 1.55 A
water.smoothness: C1 squared hinge with regularized distance; all catalog waters retained without outcome filtering
water.rationale: Same k and ratio as existing non-water repulsion; one prior setting, 0.05 ratio margin above unchanged PB 0.75 gate

local.atom_selection: Cross-fragment connection endpoints and their first graph neighbors
local.coordinates: delta in original fragment local Cartesian frame; x=(local0+delta) R.T + center + translation
local.bound: Each delta component in [-0.10/sqrt(3),+0.10/sqrt(3)] A, guaranteeing norm<=0.10 A; this is a cube, not a spherical constraint
local.nonlocal_atoms: Exactly original fragment SE(3), no independent displacement
local.rationale: One predefined 0.10 A diagnostic; not selected from test outcomes

optimizer.raw_initial_coordinates: identical for A0, A1 and B1
optimizer.stopping: Original numerical convergence or budget; no outcome-dependent stopping

variants.A0_B0: Unmodified original repair function, no water/local flexibility; one shared control
variants.A1: Only add fixed-water energy and analytic gradient
variants.B1: Only add local port/neighbor coordinates and their position regularizer; no water energy

excluded_optional_B2: Not run; no extra all-atom comparison requested as mandatory
reporting: Strict HQ and auxiliary HQ ignoring exactly two water checks always separate. All are postprocessed saved candidates, not raw network output.
